scope: 7 translation objectives, 84 full reference triples, all 6 directed language profiles

findings.location: Состав партии проверяется по смыслу / table column Обязательное разнообразие внутри одной цели
findings.finding: The translation row makes implicit context, near-valid word contrasts and semantically wrong negation mandatory across every narrow objective. That conflicts with the per-objective contract: TR04-EXPLICIT-GENDER requires visible decisive gender/coreference evidence, while TR06-PLACEHOLDER and TR09-IDENTIFIER must change only the protected literal, not introduce negation as another task.
findings.evidence: Разные участники, явный/неявный контекст, близкое допустимое слово, семантически неверное отрицание
findings.resolution_proposal: Replace the row cell with: Разные участники и только оси назначенной карточки; весь решающий контекст видим ученику. Отрицание, лексическая неоднозначность, род и защищённые токены варьируются только в своих микроцелях. Контрольные варианты остаются внутри той же темы.
findings.verification: One scoped wording change in campaign; reference triples need no changes for this finding.

bounded_observations.observation: Negation-report/promise pairs change scope; non-symmetric praise/transfer pairs reverse agent/recipient; completion pairs now align by-noon report semantics. No concrete case found where both chosen and rejected are valid under the stated visible contract.

Engineer/client pairs provide explicit pronoun/agreement evidence and visible coreference clarification. No profession-only inference is needed for the discriminating preference. The note about unknown-gender source prevents propagating these chosen genders to underspecified prompts.

Door-lock context distinguishes physical key from solution key; driver/cursor context distinguishes computer mouse from animal. The requested output explicitly allows an unambiguous short phrase; no hidden metadata is needed to select the target sense.

All placeholder source/chosen multisets match exactly; each rejected changes the assigned literal. Identifiers preserve exact case/spelling in chosen and the visible prompt makes case sensitivity/no aliases explicit. Direction is determined by prose, not Latin text inside placeholders.

Each underlying scenario uses a shared family across all six directions. Completion refinements retain existing TR03 family ancestry. All 84 rows are public reference and marked training_allowed=false. Fourteen declared families are not evidence of fourteen new independent training/exam sources.
A targeted structural pass found all metadata.language_pair values match profile, source_raw matches the prompt ending, and full prompt/chosen/rejected strings are mirrored in their cards.
Token preservation and language checking are data admission checks; cards require actual learning before any learner improvement claim and retain the 0-to-0 prohibition.
